page.overview:
Who is Douglas Adams?

Captain Douglas Adams was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century.

In 2364, he was the commander of the . Sometime in that year, he received an order about modifications to the Sector 500/32450 survey from Dent Arthur Dent of the Sirius Cybernetics Corporation. The captain was requested to send acknowledgement of the receipt of this order through subspace com net security code 045, code 100 alpha. (, okudagram)
